title: Packers think Micah Parsons will be "pretty close" to return after four games

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers think Micah Parsons will be "pretty close" to return after four games
sources.description: Defensive end Micah Parsons will miss the first four games of the season because he is on the physically unable to perform list and the question of how many more he might miss was a topic at Packers General Manager Brian Gutekunst's press conference on Tuesday.
